item.title: White Cross #4 T-Shirt
item.description: This clean and minimalist white cross design offers a subtle yet powerful statement on any product. Whether printed on t-shirts, hoodies, or home decor items like pillows and tapestries, this timeless symbol adds a touch of elegance and faith to your style or space. Perfect for those who appreciate simplicity and meaningful design.
